facts.material: polyvinyl chloride (PVC) with plasticizers (assumed not less than 6% by weight)
facts.form: non-adhesive, noncellular, unreinforced strip/tape in rolls

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3920 covers other plates, sheets, film, foil and strip of plastics, noncellular and not reinforced; flagging tape is a plain PVC strip
Heading 3919 excluded because the tape is not self-adhesive; chapter 49 not applicable as the tape is not printed
GRI 6: 3920.43 PVC containing not less than 6% plasticizers; 3920.43.50 other (not imitation patent leather)

rejected_alternatives.reason: flagging tape has no adhesive, so it is not a self-adhesive tape
applies to PVC with less than 6% plasticizers; the tape is plasticized (flexible)
only for printed barricade/warning tape where the printing is not incidental; plain flagging tape is unprinted
strip in rolls that is only cut to width is not worked beyond heading 3920

missing_facts: Whether the tape is printed with a message (could shift to chapter 49)
classification.rationale: Flagging tape is a non-adhesive, noncellular, unreinforced PVC strip in rolls. That falls in heading 3920 rather than 3919 (self-adhesive) or 3926. Being plasticized PVC, it falls in 3920.43, and 3920.43.50.00 as not being imitation patent leather. NY N332349 (in force) classified a non-adhesive PVC tape in 3920.43.5000.
